metadata.canonicalQuery:
fetch spans, from:"2026-09-19T08:26:57.691Z", to:"2026-09-19T08:27:01.889Z"
| filter service.namespace == "easytrade-otel-lab" AND service.name == "broker-service"
| summarize by:{span.kind, http.request.method, http.route, http.response.status_code, span.status_code}, spans = countDistinct(span.id)
| sort spans desc
